managed_state.co_owned_config_strategy: Marked block merge for config.toml, tui.toml, and AGENTS.md; exact managed files for nddev-builder skills, agents, hooks, and mcp.json
managed_state.legacy_schema_policy: schema-1 setup state is readable for status, migrate, restore, and remove; launch refuses it

software_lifecycle.presence_signal: software-status JSON exposes present=true and presence entries for NDDEV-KIMICODE-SOFTWARE.json, .nddev-kimicode-software, .nddev-kimicode-software/current, or bin/kimi
software_lifecycle.install_precondition: install-cli refuses existing target-owned software presence unless current
software_lifecycle.update_precondition: update-cli repairs non-legacy official-binary target-owned software presence and refuses absent or legacy software state
software_lifecycle.migrate_precondition: migrate-cli is the only transition from legacy Bun schema to official-binary schema
software_lifecycle.remove_precondition: remove-cli is a deterministic no-op when target-owned software presence is absent and otherwise removes only target-owned software paths

runtime_launch.target_environment_scope: target-owned /absolute/target/bin/kimi with isolated HOME, TMPDIR, and KIMI_CODE_HOME; credentials, sessions, logs, skills, agents, plugins, MCP, updates, and runtime data stay under the explicit target
runtime_launch.lifecycle_lock_scope: Target-bound mutation and launch acquire the persistent external product anchor first before target filesystem observation, canonicalization runs under that product handoff, the canonical target anchor is opened or published under exclusive product coordination, product coordination is released after target-anchor handoff, target-local internal lock is acquired second for mutations and launch, and locks are held from launch preflight through child process completion and cleanup; internal is released first and external target locks last. Read-only commands create no product or target anchor; cold no-anchor reads use the contract's double-check path, and seeded reads open existing anchors without creation.
runtime_launch.mutable_runtime_paths: The managed target root, runtime HOME, runtime TMPDIR, KIMI_CODE_HOME, config, session, plugin, MCP, and log locations remain writable by the launched CLI
runtime_launch.pre_handoff_executable_revalidation: Immediately before subprocess handoff, only the dedicated lock directory, launcher bin directory, and immutable software artifact directories are made read/execute-only; /absolute/target/bin/kimi is reopened without following symlinks and checked for regular file type, current-user ownership, mode 0700, stable inode, and pinned official-binary digest
runtime_launch.portable_handoff_mechanism: latest revalidated path handoff with an O_NOFOLLOW identity/digest evidence fd held until the child is spawned; exact-inode fd execution is not the portable macOS contract and is not claimed on supported hosts
runtime_launch.lifecycle_lock_mechanism: fcntl.flock lifecycle locks: a monotonic 0600 external product anchor named global.lock under the fixed validated product/UID 0700 system temp root (/private/tmp on macOS, /tmp on Linux), a monotonic 0600 canonical target anchor keyed by full sha256 of product namespace plus canonical absolute target, and a persistent 0600 target-local regular lock file under a dedicated target-local lock directory. Missing external anchors are published only by mutating commands with complete fsynced no-replace binding publication; final-path visibility is the rollback commit point, parent-directory sync completes crash durability, and existing anchors are never truncated, rebound, replaced, or unlinked during ordinary lifecycle cleanup. Read-only status, plan, and software-status do not create anchors, and the dedicated target-local lock directory is write-protected to 0500 while held then restored to 0700. Irreversible cleanup retirement uses an immutable complete cleanup journal with relative tombstone names, no-replace publication, read-only report-only cleanup_pending state, malformed-state fail-closed behavior, and mutation-only drain or bounded publication-alias recovery before active state changes
runtime_launch.same_uid_tamper_boundary: No OS sandbox or independent trust anchor is claimed against deliberate same-UID chmod, target entrypoint replacement, or fixed bootstrap-root tampering outside the manager; hashes and stamps are integrity checks for manager-owned lifecycle drift, not authenticity against a same-UID writer. Ordinary target-local lock-file unlink and internal lock-parent rename bypass are denied while the protected launch path and external bootstrap lock are held

native_projection.skills: all files under builder/nddev-builder/skills/ projected to KIMI_CODE_HOME/skills/
native_projection.hooks: hook source projected; active blocking hook only in safe profile
native_projection.MCP: mcp.json managed without bundled servers or secrets
native_projection.plugins: builder/nddev-builder/kimi.plugin.json remains source packaging only unless Kimi native plugin management installs it
